exposure: COOK R Cervical Ripening Balloon (CCRB) for cervical maturity
cohort: The medical records of 415 pregnant women requiring IOL from January 2018 to October 2022 were retrospectively reviewed.
finding: A nomogram was successfully developed for predicting caesarean delivery after IOL in pregnancies with CCRB treatment using factors including parity, modified Bishop score at induction and artificial rupture of membrane.
